messages:
Ellie: Promo is blocked — staging-e2e failing for auth-service on refresh token tests since 15:30 UTC. Seeing consistent 401s.

Raj: Paste failure? flaky or deterministic?

Ellie: ```
FAIL tests/e2e/test_refresh_token.py::test_refresh_rotations
E AssertionError: expected 200 but got 401
E Response headers: {\"x-cache-status\":\"HIT\", \"x-cache-ttl\":\"-1\"}
```

Tomas: x-cache-ttl = -1 -> CI fixture cache returning stale entry. We merged a token payload schema change earlier today.

Ellie: Re-ran with cache off (CI_FIXTURE_CACHE=0) and it passed. With cache on it's reproducible in this canary.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused: failing check `staging-e2e` (job 6803123501). Auto-rollback disabled.

Raj: Quick options: 1) pin to last-good image sha256:bb99aa00 + manual promote, 2) revert change. Pin wins for release window.

Tomas: I'll run fixture eviction after pin: `ci/tools/invalidate-fixtures --svc=auth-service --env=staging` (est ~2m). Then re-run canary.

Ellie: Oncall Raj, approve pin+promote?

Raj: Approve. Doing manual promote now: `deploybot promote --image=sha256:bb99aa00 --env=staging --manual`. Then eviction and retry.

ci-bot: Manual promote initiated by Raj. Canary redeployed to sha256:bb99aa00 (link: https://ci.internal/6803123501).

Tomas: Eviction ran; re-run smoke -> canary green. Staging e2e all green.

Ellie: Creating follow-up ticket RD-7812 to fix fixture cache TTL handling and add CI guard for negative TTLs. Assigning to Platform, P2 post-release. Attaching logs.

Raj: Adding release-note blurb: "auth-service pinned to last-good image due to CI fixture cache TTL regression; see RD-7812 for follow-up and unpin schedule."

deploy-bot: Promotion completed. Release window unblocked. :tada:

Ellie: Thanks — we'll unpin in a maintenance window after the release and include ops runbook steps for manual eviction.
